description: This file contains React components and utility functions for rendering markdown content with support for mathematical notation, diagrams (Mermaid), syntax highlighting, and rich formatting in a Next.js/React project.

classes.name: Mermaid
classes.description: React component that renders a Mermaid diagram from provided code, with error handling and the ability to view SVG in a new window.

methods.name: PreCode
methods.description: React component that detects Mermaid code blocks within a <pre> element and renders Mermaid diagrams.

methods.name: escapeDollarNumber
methods.description: Utility function that escapes dollar signs followed by numbers for LaTeX rendering.

methods.name: escapeBrackets
methods.description: Utility function that escapes bracketed expressions for LaTeX rendering.

methods.name: _MarkDownContent
methods.description: Internal component that processes and renders markdown content with plugins for math, tables, code highlighting, and custom rendering components.
